note: CombinedNarrow is a projection of Combined whose Child column serves the annual and the monthly variant; its own cell Extra is annual only. A table is one file whatever variant binds it, so CombinedNarrow's one file carries Extra and its shared Child (the annual key, a monthly linking id) under both variants, and Combined's one file serves both variants' Child. Fails if a variant splits a table into a second file, or if the shared Child is dropped under either variant of a file that carries a cell of its own.
